= (6348 + 46)/2 = 6394/2 = 3197

questions.question: Find the HCF of 11/25, 12/35, 13/15 and 13/40. 11/25, 12/35, 13/15 और 13/40 का HCF ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
HCF of fractions = HCF of numerators/LCM of denominators

HCF of 11, 12, 13 and 13 = 1

25 = 52

35 = 5 * 7

15 = 3 * 5

40 = 5 * 23

LCM of denominators = 3 * 52 * 23 * 7 = 4200

HCF of fractions = 1/4200

Required number = (LCM of 11, 8, 12, 15, and 25) - 15

Factor of 11 = 11

Factor of 8 = 23

Factor of 12 = 22 * 3

Factor of 15 = 3 * 5

Factor of 25 = 52

LCM = 11 * 23 * 3 * 52 = 6600

Required number = 6600 - 15 = 6585

Let the numbers be 17a and 17b.

17ab = 5083

17ab = 17 X 13 X 23

So, numbers are 17 X 13 and 17 X 23

Sum = 17 X 13 + 17 X 23 = 612

questions.question: The LCM of 2/5, 3/8, 4/9 and 2/9 is : 2/5, 3/8, 4/9 और 2/9 का एल.सी.एम. है:
questions.solution:
LCM of fractions = LCM of numerators/HCF of denominators

LCM of 2, 3, 4, and 2 = 12

HCF of 5, 8, 9 and 9 = 1

LCM of fractions = 12/1 = 12

Required number = LCM of 36, 42, 54, 72 and 80

Factors of 36 = 2 * 2 * 3 * 3 = 22 * 32

Factors of 42 = 2 * 3 * 7

Factors of 54 = 2 * 3 * 3 * 3 = 2 * 33

Factors of 72 = 2 * 2 * 2 * 3 * 3 = 23 * 32

Factors of 80 = 2 * 2 * 2 * 2 * 5 = 24 * 5

LCM = 24 * 33 * 5 * 7 = 15120

For LCM, we take the highest power.

Taking the highest power of each digit -

Highest power of 2 = 5

Highest power of 3 = 5

Highest power of 5 = 3

Highest power of 7 = 1

Highest power of 11 = 1

LCM = 25 * 35 * 53 * 7 * 11

Required number = (LCM of 8, 10, 15, 18, 20) + 2

Factors of 8 = 23

Factors of 10 = 2 * 5

Factors of 15 = 3 * 5

Factors of 18 = 2 * 32

Factors of 20 = 22 * 5

LCM = 23 * 32 * 5 = 360

Required number = 360 + 2 = 362
